title: Wind back anti-dumping duties and test new ones against the whole economy
action: Progressively remove existing anti-dumping and countervailing measures and impose new ones only if an economy-wide cost-benefit test shows a net gain.
why: Anti-dumping duties protect a few producers by raising prices for the many local businesses that use the goods, such as steel and aluminium, reducing their competitiveness.

evidence.source: 5-year Productivity Inquiry: Advancing Prosperity, Recommendations and Reform Directives
evidence.quote: progressively removing Australia's anti-dumping and countervailing measures, and subjecting any new measures to an economy-wide cost-benefit test.
